C1062.title: Aiding Information Network Crime: Four Defendants Sentenced to Prison and Fines
C1062.summary: From late February to mid-March 2023, four defendants in Xingwen County, Sichuan, knowing that their upstream contacts were conducting telecom fraud overseas, set up and operated VOIP equipment in 16 hotels across Guizhou and Sichuan to provide communication transmission support for the fraud ring. They collected 24,329.65 yuan in illegal proceeds and were sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment ranging from eleven to six months, with fines and confiscation of illegal gains.
